# The ON FIRE ball: the same sphere, yellow with orange seams (glow ramp, unlit in the bake).
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Fire --base-color 0.9255 0.8353 0.4275 --no-slot
material new FireSeam --base-color 0.9176 0.4667 0.1882 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Ball --segments 10 --rings 7 --radius 0.15 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 0 18
apply --rotation
material assign Fire
active Ball
mode edit
select face where "(pos.z < 0.035 && pos.z > -0.035) || (pos.x < 0.03 && pos.x > -0.03)"
material assign FireSeam
mode object
shade flat
export fire.glb
